summary: P1 Listings Moderation + Admin Signup Enrichment regression. 13/13 backend pytest PASS covering: signup with/without ref_code (country + referred_by_* enrichment), GET /admin/listings/pending auth guard + shape (total/single_count/multi_count/listings + _listing_type/_seller_email/_seller_name enrichment), public /api/listings excludes pending (regression), reject validation (missing reason 400, <5 chars 400, valid reason 200 with audit log + rejection_reason persisted), approve flips status to active + writes audit log, double-approve 400, approve/reject non-existent 404, non-admin 401/403. Frontend smoke: login+admin nav was blocked by cookie-consent overlay in Playwright (non-functional UI issue for automation only — cookie banner covers the login submit button at 1920x1080). Main agent smoke screenshot already confirmed ListingsModeration page renders with counters + data-testids. All data-testids verified present in the component source.

issues: Cookie consent overlay at bottom covers the Login submit button at default viewport — users must accept/refuse cookies before they can click Login. Not a P0 regression but degrades first-visit UX and breaks automated login tests. Consider auto-dismiss on scroll or repositioning.

action_items: (Optional) Reposition cookie-consent banner so it does not overlap the Login submit button at 1920x1080 viewport — currently blocks both real users and test automation.
(Optional) Consider splitting auth.py (1180+ lines) — carry-over from iteration 162.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops.py moderation endpoints correctly: validate reason length (>=5), use _find_pending_listing helper to cover both listings and multi_item_listings collections, enforce pending-status check on both approve/reject (prevents double-action), wrap email sends in try/except and schedule via BackgroundTasks (non-blocking), write admin_audit_logs entries with admin_id/admin_email/reason, invalidate listing cache on approve.
GET /admin/listings/pending enriches with _seller_email/_seller_name via a single batched db.users.find({'id': {'$in': seller_ids}}) — good N+1 avoidance.

_ModerateAction Pydantic model marks reason Optional — explicit manual validation inside handler returns proper 400 with user-facing detail message ('A rejection reason is required so the seller knows what to fix.') — matches frontend chip UX.
Non-admin guard via Depends(require_admin) verified returning 403 for unauthenticated calls on /admin/listings/pending.
Public GET /api/listings already filters status='active' — pending listings do NOT leak (regression test confirms).
